name: adni_synthseg_hippocampus_spiral_ae_reconstruction
purpose: Beat PCA reconstruction at matched latent dimension and export latents for the downstream cocycle / Brain-ODE flow network.

dataset.template: mean training shape on the shared correspondence topology

metric.name: vertex_rmse_mm
metric.definition: per-scan RMSE over coordinates, in mm (NOT per-vertex Euclidean distance, which is sqrt(3) larger)
metric.gate: fit_pca_baseline.py refuses to proceed unless PCA-128 val reproduces 0.033667 within 1e-4

pca_targets_vertex_rmse_mm.note: The stored cohort PCA model caps at 150 components; 256 was refit by fit_pca_baseline.py.

model.latent: encoder emits latent_channels directly; no mu/log_var, no KL, no reparameterisation
model.selection: lowest validation vertex_rmse_mm; test split evaluated exactly once per study

adaptive.deviation: upstream Dynamic_spiral_pool.__init__ has a bare `self.reset_parameters` (missing call), so the spiral-length predictor is never zero-initialised; this port calls it

guards.rationale: the operator materialises [B, N, max_seq, C] tensors, so it is applied only on coarse levels as in the paper's own CoMA config

space.seq_length: 9..27 step 2 (clamped per level to vertex_count // dilation)
space.dynamic_seq_frac: 0.25..1.0 of level vertex count (adaptive conv type only)

search.structural_prune: trials whose pre-latent width is below 2x the latent are pruned untrained; the stock SpiralNet++ hierarchy funnels through 11x64=704 features, under the 8238 input dimensions

latent_export_schema.row_order: manifest order within each split, identical to the PCA files
